verdicts.title: threads.ts is an 8,990-line module owning ten subsystems
verdicts.note: wc -l threads.ts = 8990; 86 module-level let/Map/Set singletons; resetThreadsStoreForTests at 8845 is a hand-maintained clear list; liveControls.ts:65 states threads.ts cannot import it without a cycle; tasksPanel.ts:5-9 documents a lazy reach-back to avoid a cycle; 68 commits to threads.ts since 2026-09-01. Extraction is sound but risk is real (module-load wiring order).

verdicts.title: Test seams live in production modules
verdicts.note: Confirmed: 42 exported ForTests/ForTesting symbols in non-test store files, four *ForTesting methods on TranscriptRepository (341, 570, 581, 620, 646), import.meta.env.MODE checks at threads.ts:8373 and mutationOutboxIndexedDB.ts:194, 117 files import resetThreadsStoreForTests (1,123 reset*ForTests( calls, not 1,680). The *ForTesting accessors are used by tests, so moving them is a larger job than deleting the two unused seams.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Step 1 (safe, small): delete threadRoutingIndexesForTests and resetEntryWriteAdmissionForTests (0 callers). Step 2: add a store reset registry only if Jesse wants it (YAGNI risk, it adds a mechanism); the MODE checks can be replaced by an injected factory but ask Jesse. Leave the *ForTesting snapshot accessors until the TranscriptRepository split (web-stores-16).

verdicts.title: Item-position comparator copied into three modules
verdicts.note: transcriptRepository.ts:134 and sessionEntryCache.ts:210 comparePosition are copies of package comparePositions (reducer.ts:3564, exported from index.ts:519). But sessionEntryCache's compareNullablePosition (230) sorts null FIRST while the package comparator sorts missing LAST, so it is semantically different and must not be swapped for the package function.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Replace the two local comparePosition functions with package comparePositions (adapting null to undefined at call sites or adding a null-tolerant overload). Keep compareNullablePosition as is, or rename it to say null sorts first. Guard with sessionEntryCache and transcriptRepository tests.

verdicts.title: connection.ts monkey-patches the package core store
verdicts.note: Patch is real (connection.ts:76-87 overwrites getState/getInitialState/setState/subscribe in place via cast, with a WeakMap memo). But the call-site count is wrong: 'getState().connect(' occurs 756 times, 25 in non-test files (15 outside dev/) and the rest across 182 test files, not ~36. Fix is much larger than stated and a test spy (threads.connection.test.ts:152) depends on setState identity.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Either leave it (works, documented) or do a codemod for the ~756 sites and delete withConnect/WeakMap/overrides (~-70 source, ~756 one-line edits mostly in tests). Ask Jesse; YAGNI says low priority.

verdicts.title: Connection-following lifecycle and fencing hand-rolled in six stores
verdicts.note: keybindings.ts:45-100 and transcriptDisplay.ts:420-495 share a rewireClient/onConnectionChange skeleton, but they differ materially (transcriptDisplay creates and disposes a package store per client, bumps lifecycleEpoch, guards re-entrancy; keybindings detachHub/setSupport). readyGenerationCallback.ts exists to drop stale ready firings (per its header), not merely so the two stores do not contend. 19 'connectionStore.getState().client !==' fences found (agentsDoc 3, commandCatalog 2, hostOps 12, hosts 2). Package readyGenerationFence.ts exists. -250 estimate is overstated.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Limit to: reuse package readyGenerationFence in agentsDoc/commandCatalog if semantically equal (verify first), and optionally share the begin/end/detach skeleton. Expect about -80 net; do not force-fit transcriptDisplay.

verdicts.title: Transcript-display persistence duplicate key tables
verdicts.note: Key tables duplicated: prefs.ts:155-157 vs transcriptDisplay/localStore.ts:6-9 (differ only by the evener.prefs. prefix), legacy key lists at prefs.ts:160-167 and localStore.ts:11-18. Aliases readLegacyPref, hasLegacyPref, writeLegacyBool, removeLegacyPref, migrateLegacyPrefs, dualWriteLegacyPrefs have zero references repo-wide (prefs.ts:237-265). But prefs' writeTranscriptDisplayLocal is best-effort while localStore.writeLocal is read-back verified, so they are not interchangeable duplicates.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Delete the six aliases; derive localStore.LOCAL_KEYS and LEGACY_KEYS from prefs.ts exports (one owner). Leave verified vs best-effort write semantics distinct unless callers of prefs' writeTranscriptDisplayLocal/removeTranscriptDisplayLocal are shown unused (only prefs.ts uses writeTranscriptDisplayLocal) in which case delete the unused ones.

verdicts.title: History and review-narrative comments
verdicts.note: Real examples: prefs.ts:373 'A persona panel voted 3-1', prefs.ts:397 '2026-08-14 reversal', threads.ts:6373/7022 'task-15-report.md', threads.ts:8958 '(kata ycet)', pendingUrlRemovals.ts:9 'roborev's seventh round'. But my regex found only 14 such hits in non-test store files, not 98; the comment-density claim (threads.ts ~3,050 comment lines of 8,990) holds. Deleting 2,000-3,000 lines of comments is risky because many carry race-fence invariants.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Delete only narrative references (round/kata/persona/task-report/issue ids, dated reversals) as touched by other changes; do not mass-delete comments.
